rendering_findings.source_content: **Proof technique:** Take $g(x)=x^{-a}$ with $0<a<1/q$, normalize the extremizer $|g|^{q-1}$ explicitly, and compute both norms by one-variable power integrals.
rendering_findings.symptom: The uppercase technique banner renders inline $...$ math delimiters literally (including $g(x)=x^{-a}$ and $0<a<1/q$).
rendering_findings.note: Uppercase technique styling is expected; the raw math delimiters in this banner are the defect.

rendering_findings.source_content: **Proof technique:** Choose nonnegative functions with $|f|^p$ and $|g|^q$ proportional almost everywhere and invoke the equality theorem.
rendering_findings.symptom: The uppercase technique banner renders $|f|^p$ and $|g|^q$ with literal dollar delimiters.
rendering_findings.note: Uppercase technique styling is expected; the raw math delimiters in this banner are the defect.

rendering_findings.source_content: **Proof technique:** If $\mu(E)=0$, then $\mathbf 1_E$ is the zero class in $L^p$, so the induced set function must vanish on $E$.
rendering_findings.symptom: The uppercase technique banner renders the raw \$ delimiters and TeX command in \$\mathbf 1_E\$.
rendering_findings.note: Uppercase technique styling is expected; raw inline math in this banner is the defect.

optional_typography.observation: Wikilinks in ItemBodies render as block lines by design; reference-title lines and punctuation wrapping alone were not counted as defects.
Proof-technique banners use the expected uppercase styling; three banners also contain raw math delimiters and are listed as confirmed display defects.
Plain L^1/L^2 title typography was left unreported per the assignment-specific allowance.
The 129 standalone image tiles were inspected at original resolution. Long items use overlapping adjacent crops; no standalone clipping was confirmed.
